title: The Trapp Family
creator: Wolfgang Liebeneiner
description: Die Trapp-Familie: a West German film of Maria von Trapp’s memoir, a big hit in Europe. Its success led to the Broadway musical and then to the Hollywood film, which follow its story closely.

title: The Sound of Music
creator: Robert Wise
description: The Hollywood musical, starring Julie Andrews, about a novice nun who becomes governess to the von Trapp children. It was filmed around Salzburg in 1964, and tours still visit its locations, though many Austrians have never seen it.

title: The Salzburg Connection
creator: Lee H. Katzin
description: A Cold War thriller, based on a Helen MacInnes novel, about an American lawyer on holiday who gets caught up in a hunt for Nazi documents hidden in a lake near Salzburg. It was shot on location in the city.
